title: PaliKeyConfig
description: Configuration schema for the PaliKey cross-platform Pāḷi input method engine

version.description: Semantic version of the configuration format

niggahita.description: Niggahīta variant: dot_below (ṃ U+1E43, PTS/SuttaCentral standard) or dot_above (ṁ U+1E41, VRI tradition)

extended_set.description: Enable extended Sanskrit/IAST characters (ṛ ṝ ḹ ḥ ś ṣ ē ō)

enabled.description: Enable escape mechanisms for typing literal non-Pāḷi words

escape_char.description: Single character prefix that bypasses sequence composition

undo_by_backspace.description: Backspace immediately after composed character restores raw sequence

repeat_key_escapes.description: Typing trigger key again immediately restores raw sequence plus trigger key
